key_insight: APEX-Agents introduces a realistic productivity benchmark for AI agents and shows that even top models struggle on long-horizon, cross-application workplace tasks—Gemini 3 Flash (Thinking=High) achieves the top Pass@1 of 24.0%.
problem_solved: Provides a standardized way to evaluate whether AI agents can reliably execute complex, multi-step tasks across files and tools typical of investment banking, consulting, and corporate law workflows.
method: Design a benchmark (APEX-Agents) composed of long-horizon, cross-application tasks authored by domain experts (bankers, consultants, lawyers).
Place agents in realistic work environments with files and interactive tools and measure end-to-end task success using Pass@1.
Run a leaderboard evaluation of eight agents to compare real-world productivity capabilities and surface failure modes.
impact: APEX-Agents shifts agent evaluation toward realistic workplace utility, enabling practitioners to compare models on end-to-end task execution and prioritize improvements in reliability, tool use, and long-horizon planning.
visual_elements: Leaderboard bar chart showing Pass@1 scores (highlight Gemini 3 Flash at 24.0%).
Flow diagram of a long-horizon task crossing multiple apps/files (inputs → steps → tools → output).
Heatmap or radar chart of common failure modes (planning, tool use, file handling, hallucination).
Domain icons (investment banking, consulting, corporate law) with sample task thumbnails to show real-world provenance.
paper_authors: Bertie Vidgen, Austin Mann, Abby Fennelly, John Wright Stanly, Lucas Rothman
